title: How MariaDB BEAT Oracle
description:
When Oracle acquired Sun Microsystems in 2009, it also inherited MySQL.

Many assumed the database would continue to dominate.

Instead, its original creator forked the project, created MariaDB, and much of the ecosystem followed.

In this short, we explore one of the biggest lessons in open source.

Oracle didn't lose because MariaDB had better features.

It lost because developers stopped trusting the steward behind the project.

Because in open source, trust isn't a nice-to-have.

It's the foundation everything else is built on.
